summary: MINISO Group filed a 6-K announcing a new HK$2 billion share repurchase program authorized by its board, effective June 30, 2026 for 12 months. The program covers ordinary shares and ADSs (each ADS = 4 shares) via open-market or private transactions, funded from surplus cash. The board cites share price below intrinsic value and confidence in the business. A prior HK$2 billion program (Aug 2024 to June 2026) resulted in ~HK$1.37 billion repurchased. Repurchases are subject to annual shareholder repurchase mandates (10% of issued shares). Watch for execution pace and potential EPS accretion; no premium or fixed price terms.
